name: Claude Code CLI
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI on a selectable channel.

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.

disableNonessentialTraffic.description: Set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 to suppress telemetry and other non-essential network calls.

settingsJson.description: Claude settings as JSON with backslash-escaped quotes, written to settings.json.
